annotations.title: Let the Doctor fix a graded slip

description: The app’s Fix it on an owned saved Grade jobId whose report says fixable.offered (get_grade_report): the Doctor reprices, swaps or drops the weak legs at the slip’s own sportsbook and returns its estimate exactly as the app shows it: state fixed / best_reachable / no_moves, before and target letters, after (the Doctor’s estimate, re-grade to confirm; never a saved Grade), steps per leg, blockers, payout, placeable, regradeQuote and fixedTicket, the fixed slip saved as an unplaced linked ticket. A Grade the Doctor cannot fix answers fix_not_offered with its reason. Paid plans only, under the app’s daily fix cap; costs no Grade. Keep commandKey (16-120 characters) stable for retries; a replay returns the same estimate. Never places a wager or moves money.
